name: week
title: The fortnight
subtitle: Moves booked, crew hours, quotes to chase and money owed

sections.title: Moves in the next 14 days
sections.sql: select j.move_on, j.name as job, j.customer, j.kind, j.volume_m3, j.crew_booked, j.trucks, case when j.deposit = 0 then 'none asked' when j.deposit_paid >= j.deposit then 'paid' else 'not paid' end as deposit, coalesce(j.insurance, 'not asked') as insurance from job_detail j where j.status = 'booked' and j.move_on between mover_today() and mover_today() + 14 order by j.move_on

sections.title: Crew diary
sections.note: Days over the fatigue limit for heavy vehicle drivers are flagged (NHVR standard hours by default; the profile holds the limit).
sections.sql: select d.work_on, d.crew, d.role, d.hours, d.jobs, case when d.drove_heavy and d.hours > p.max_work_hours then 'over limit' else '' end as flag from crew_days d cross join company_profile p where d.work_on between mover_today() and mover_today() + 14 order by d.work_on, d.crew

sections.title: Quotes to chase
sections.sql: select j.name as job, j.customer, j.quote_amount, j.quote_sent_on, j.quote_valid_to, j.move_on, case when j.quote_valid_to < mover_today() then 'expired' when coalesce(j.last_follow_up_on, j.quote_sent_on) <= mover_today() - p.follow_up_days then 'follow up' else 'waiting' end as stage from job_detail j cross join company_profile p where j.status = 'quoted' order by j.move_on

sections.title: Money owed
sections.sql: select name as invoice, customer, job, kind, balance, due_on, mover_today() - due_on as days_overdue from invoice_balances where not void and balance > 0 and due_on < mover_today() order by due_on

name: sales
title: Quotes and wins
subtitle: Where the work comes from, what is won and lost, and how good the estimates are

sections.title: Win rate by source, last 12 months
sections.sql: select coalesce(source, 'unknown') as source, count(*) as enquiries, count(*) filter (where status in ('booked', 'completed')) as won, count(*) filter (where status = 'lost') as lost, coalesce(sum(quote_amount) filter (where status in ('booked', 'completed')), 0) as value_won from jobs where enquiry_on >= mover_today() - 365 group by 1 order by value_won desc

sections.title: Lost and why
sections.sql: select name as job, coalesce(lost_reason, 'not recorded') as reason, quote_amount, enquiry_on from jobs where status = 'lost' order by enquiry_on desc

sections.title: Estimated hours against actual
sections.sql: select name as job, kind, est_hours, actual_hours, actual_hours - est_hours as over_hours from jobs where status = 'completed' and est_hours is not null and actual_hours is not null order by completed_on desc

name: storage
title: Storage
subtitle: Every account, the overdue ladder and rates below today's standard

sections.title: Accounts
sections.sql: select name as account, customer, containers, location, rate, billed_to, owing, days_overdue from storage_detail where status = 'active' order by name

sections.title: Overdue
sections.note: Overdue notice from 30 days, final notice from 60, sale or disposal no sooner than 28 days after the final notice (the profile holds your periods).
sections.sql: select name as account, customer, owing, days_overdue, overdue_notice_on, final_notice_on from storage_detail where status = 'active' and days_overdue > 0 order by days_overdue desc

sections.title: Under the standard rate
sections.sql: select name as account, customer, rate, standard_rate, standard_rate - rate as gap, coalesce(last_increase_on, start_on) as last_change from storage_detail where status = 'active' and rate < standard_rate order by standard_rate - rate desc
